00051 void WhiteNoiseUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int channel) throw()
00052 {
00053     int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00054     float* outputSamples = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00055     
00056     unsigned long s1, s2, s3;
00057     random.get(s1, s2, s3);
00058

00060     {
00061         *outputSamples++ = Ran088::nextBiFloat(s1, s2, s3);
00062     }
00063     
00064     random.set(s1, s2, s3);
00065 }
